message:
Keep question visible on buzz and allow manual buzzer release

On the game page the buzz banner now slides in over the title bar
without dimming, so question and image stay readable. Hosts can
release a buzz without judging, undo the last judgement, re-open all
locked teams and re-open a question after the answer was shown.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add fixed game list and buzzer quiz for Allgemeinwissen

The 13 games of the evening are now defined in code and can only be
reordered; Arschbolzen can switch to its bad-weather variant
Kippmoment. Games plug into a small registry of game kinds; the first
kind is a buzzer quiz with its own protected question list (optional
images in a private bucket), a host-only countdown that never blocks,
answer reveal on the projector and scoring from round points.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Remove separate test-run mode

One game state and one buzzer row instead of live/test copies. Dry
runs are cleaned up with the existing reset levels. The schema
migrates an existing database in place when run again.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Remove context folder from repository

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Grant table privileges explicitly in schema

New Supabase projects no longer expose new tables to the API roles
automatically, so the projector could not read the state at all.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Add Sober Games evening website with buzzer

Show view for the projector (3D logo intro, team draw wheel, games
overview with finale, standings, winner) and a host control panel.
Scoring 3/2/1 per game with the last game counting triple, freely
reorderable games and matchball hints. Team buzzer on phones via
secret per-team QR codes, backed by Supabase with a local fallback.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
